description: Approved-correct captures checked by scripts/test-desktop-qualification.py. Every listed entry becomes a hard gate failure on a matching-dimension pixel difference.

references.scene: locked sign-in card before any input
references.rationale: Deterministic: no clock, no animation, no input-dependent state. Verified after restoring the inkless-glyph bitmap fallback in Canvas::draw_text_proportional; all headline characters render on one baseline.

deferred.reason: Taskbar clock is wall-clock time, so the pixels are not deterministic across runs.
Pre-existing materially-changed-framebuffer flake; the capture is timing-sensitive and not yet a stable oracle.
